serialization: JSON with sorted Unicode codepoint keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, no trailing newline
strings: Unicode NFC; normative text whitespace collapsed; lexical case retained
productState: normalized config plus sorted {id,type,revision,semanticFingerprint}; excludes current.md, proof files, caches, docs, application files, Git metadata
checkedTree: Hash of normalized config and complete normalized canonical object representations including revision, excluding non-normative prose
specIdentity: Sorted paths and normalized semantic content of normative contract sections and JSON definitions. Exclude README, docs, audit/provenance, source wrappers, comments, $comment, description, examples and rationale-only S-023. Contract source requirement text retains its force.
checkerIdentity: SHA-256 of all runtime module paths/content with LF line endings; checkerVersion is informational, checkerBuild binds PASS.
markdownIdentity: Within compiled clause boundaries, exclude headings/presentation, comments, rationale-only S-023 and the explicitly delimited illustrative/explanatory regions below. Regex boundaries are normative identity policy; the remaining live source requirement text retains force.
